reason: A DeepSeek Harness plugin for editable, session-isolated personalization memory, including profile and preference management, memory tools, auditing, optional extraction, and configurable context compaction.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供按会话隔离的可编辑个性化记忆、记忆工具、审计记录及可选的上下文压缩控制。
summaries.en: Provides DeepSeek Harness with editable session-isolated personalization memory, memory tools, audit history, and optional context-compaction controls.

capabilities: Stores editable personalization memory in a session-keyed sidecar
Provides model-facing tools to get and update session memory
Adds optional automatic extraction using an auxiliary model request
Provides user controls for memory editing, auditing, role presets, and context compaction
